proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 48 prints /aike/ “to come,” where -ike is the Darai infinitive ending. Turner1200 lists Prakrit āvēi/āvaï “comes,” Nepali āunu, Oriya āibā and Old Maithili āvaï; the Darai ai- stem matches this widespread “come” family.
